purpose: Define how MathBridge assembles one teacher-facing concept card from the separate curriculum, progression, representation, teaching, diagnostic and evidence layers.
resolution_order: Resolve curriculum placement and progression for CN plus the selected comparison system.
Apply grade/stage filters without forcing same-numbered-grade equivalence.
Resolve canonical representations and their system-specific evidence/status.
Resolve misconceptions relevant to the concept.
Resolve diagnostic questions that target those misconceptions.
Resolve source IDs and source metadata for every surfaced factual claim.
Assemble teacher-facing sections only after evidence/status gating.

teacher_facing_sections.rule: Show curriculum expectation/placement, not inferred classroom practice.
Only state system-specific use when its representation status supports the claim; otherwise present it as a pedagogically useful option, not a national norm.
Recommend moves because they fit the concept/representation/evidence, not because teachers from a country are assumed to teach in a particular style.
Separate research-supported pedagogical rationale from curriculum requirements.
Never frame a misconception as characteristic of a nationality without comparative empirical evidence.
A wrong answer is a signal to probe, not a diagnosis. Include at least one follow-up explanation or representation prompt.

teacher_facing_sections.title_en: Try this in your Chinese classroom
teacher_facing_sections.title_cn: 可以带回中国课堂的做法
teacher_facing_sections.rule: Recommend an adaptation that complements the Chinese curriculum rather than implying that Chinese teaching should be replaced by a foreign method.
Display the smallest set of authoritative sources needed to support the surfaced claims, with claim-level locators where available.

status_gates.verified: May be surfaced as a factual curriculum/source claim.
status_gates.partially_verified: May be surfaced only with a qualification explaining what remains unverified.
status_gates.research_required: Do not surface as an established fact; either omit or label as pending research.
status_gates.current_specifics_pending: May describe the general pedagogical function, but not claim current grade-specific PEP use.
status_gates.grade_placement_pending: Do not infer an exact Chinese grade from stage-level or legacy textbook evidence.

china_rules: Use the 2022 MOE mathematics standard for national curriculum requirements.
Use current PEP 12th-series evidence for exact textbook sequencing only when the relevant volume/locator has been verified.
Never silently substitute a legacy PEP sequence for the current edition.
If exact current grade placement is unknown, show the verified learning stage and mark textbook sequencing as pending.
england_rules: Label the jurisdiction England when using the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Separate statutory programme-of-study requirements from DfE/NCETM teaching guidance.
us_rules: Label Common Core as the comparison baseline, not the single US curriculum.
State-specific frameworks such as California or Texas may be layered separately when requested.
Do not infer that a Common Core representation requirement dictates one classroom method.
diagnostic_rules: Require at least two pieces of evidence before recording a likely misconception: for example answer plus explanation, representation, second example or follow-up response.
Distinguish conceptual misunderstanding, procedural weakness, fluency, representation difficulty and language difficulty.
For bilingual pupils, provide a language-light or Chinese-language re-probe before concluding the mathematics itself is insecure when wording may be the barrier.
After a targeted response, recheck with a structurally similar but non-identical item.

assembly_output_schema.context: CN grade/stage plus selected comparison jurisdiction/year/grade
assembly_output_schema.representations: Selected representation records with evidence status
assembly_output_schema.diagnostic: One or more diagnostic prompts and interpretation guidance
assembly_output_schema.classroom_bridge: Generated adaptation grounded in the resolved records

integrity_checks_before_render: Every representation and teaching-move ID resolves through the canonical registry.
Every misconception and diagnostic-question ID resolves.
Every factual system-specific statement has a source or an explicit pending/research status.
No grade equivalence is inferred merely because grade/year numbers match.
No legacy PEP record is selected as current by default.
